headline: Depth Over *Noise* This Week
intro: This issue gathers long-form reporting, criticism, and profiles from across the globe, from Gwangju's biennale halls to Nuuk's contested museum plans. Expect deep dives into AI geopolitics, industrial-metal legacies, and the quiet politics of design and dress.

entries.title: Neil Young and the Chrome Hearts :: Second Song
entries.author: Justin Gage
entries.summary: At 80, Neil Young remains gloriously unfinished. Second Song, his latest with the Chrome Hearts, is a weathered, luminous meditation on memory, mortality, love, and the strange passage of time. With shimmering textures, warm harmonies, wandering tempos, and that unmistakably vulnerable voice, Young looks backward without quite letting go of the future.
